title: Size Ramsey number for star forests
summary: For given graphs $G_{1}, G_{2}, \dots, G_{t}$ and $G$, let $G\rightarrow (G_{1}, G_{2}, \dots, G_{t})$ denote that each $t$-coloring of $E(G)$ yields a monochromatic copy of $G_{i}$ in color $i$ for some $i\in [t]$. The {\it size Ramsey number} $\hat{r}(G_{1}, G_{2}, \dots, G_{t})$ is the minimum size of $G$ such that $G\rightarrow (G_{1}, G_{2}, \dots, G_{t})$. A graph $G$ is a {\it size Ramsey minimal graph} for $(G_{1}, G_{2}, \dots, G_{t})$ if $G\rightarrow (G_{1}, G_{2}, \dots, G_{t})$ and $e(G)= \hat{r}(G_{1}, G_{2}, \dots, G_{t})$. A {\it star forest} is a vertex-disjoint union of stars and a star forest is a {\it uniform star forest} if each component has the same size. In 1978, Burr, Erdős, Faudree, Rousseau and Schelp gave a conjecture about the size Ramsey number for star forests. The conjecture was confirmed for many cases but is still open. In 2025, Davoodi, Javadi, Kamranian and Raeisi gave a similar conjecture in multicolors. In this paper, we completely confirm these two conjectures. Furthermore, we characterize the size Ramsey minimal graphs for uniform star forests in multicolors.

AI.tldr: 完全证明了 Burr-Erdős 等人 1978 年提出的关于星森林 size Ramsey 数的猜想，以及 Davoodi 等人 2025 年提出的多色推广猜想。
AI.motivation: Size Ramsey 数 $\hat{r}(G_1,...,G_t)$ 是 Ramsey 理论的核心参数。星森林的 size Ramsey 数猜想由 Burr, Erdős, Faudree, Rousseau 和 Schelp 于 1978 年提出，已有大量部分结果但未完全解决。2025 年 Davoodi 等人提出了多色版本猜想。
AI.method: 组合构造与极值论证相结合。构造达到下界的 host graph 来给出上界，利用计数和结构分析证明下界。对均匀星森林还刻画了所有 size Ramsey 极小图。
AI.result: 完全确认了 Burr-Erdős 等人的单色猜想和 Davoodi 等人的多色猜想。进一步刻画了多色均匀星森林的所有 size Ramsey 极小图。
AI.conclusion: 解决了星森林 size Ramsey 数这个持续 48 年的公开问题，为 Ramsey 理论中森林类图的研究画上重要一笔。
AI.future_work: 非均匀星森林的 size Ramsey 极小图是否也有完整刻画？其他森林类（如 matchings, paths 的组合）的 size Ramsey 数。

title: Spectral bounds for distance coloring and packing parameters of graphs via semidefinite programming
summary: Using methods from spectral graph theory and semidefinite programming, we obtain sharp spectral bounds for several graph parameters related to distance colorings and packing, including the injective chromatic number, the open packing number, the injective chromatic index, and the strong chromatic index. The new spectral bounds improve several existing combinatorial bounds. Furthermore, we apply the obtained eigenvalue bounds on the first two parameters to estimate the code covering number and the open packing number of hypercubes, obtaining new exact values and strengthened bounds regarding the existing literature. The obtained results illustrate the power of combining spectral and semidefinite programming tools for tackling coloring and packing problems in graph theory and coding theory.

AI.tldr: 用谱图论和半定规划方法得到距离着色和 packing 参数（injective chromatic number, open packing number, strong chromatic index 等）的精确谱界。
AI.motivation: 距离着色（如 injective coloring, strong edge coloring）和 packing 参数在图论和编码论中有重要应用。传统的组合界往往不够紧，谱方法有望给出更好的界。
AI.method: 结合谱图论（特征值方法）和半定规划（SDP）技术。利用图的邻接矩阵、Laplacian 矩阵的特征值推导目标参数的下界/上界，通过 SDP 优化得到更紧的界。
AI.result: 获得了 injective chromatic number, open packing number, injective chromatic index, strong chromatic index 的精确谱界，改进了多个已有的组合界。应用于超立方体，得到了 code covering number 和 open packing number 的新精确值和更强的界。
AI.conclusion: 展示了谱方法与半定规划结合在处理着色和 packing 问题上的强大能力，在超立方体上取得了实质性的新结果。
AI.future_work: 该方法能否推广到其他距离着色参数（如 $L(p,q)$-labeling）？在更多图类（如 Cayley 图、强正则图）上的应用。

title: Localization of spectral Turán theorems for signed graphs
summary: In this paper, we extend localized Turán theorems to signed graphs and study the corresponding spectral Turán problems. Firstly, we establish a vertex-localized Turán-type inequality for signed graphs and characterize the extremal graphs reaching this bound. Secondly, we derive a sharp upper bound for the largest eigenvalue of a signed graph via localized Turán parameters, and identify the extremal graphs attaining equality. Finally, we generalize a walk-based local spectral Turán inequality to signed graphs. Our results generalize and improve several existing theorems for unsigned and signed graphs.

AI.tldr: 将局部 Turán 定理推广至带符号图，建立顶点局部化 Turán 型不等式，并得到带符号图最大特征值的精确上界。
AI.motivation: 局部 Turán 定理（localized Turán）是经典 Turán 理论的重要新发展，关注图中局部的边密度约束。带符号图的谱 Turán 问题因其在谱图论中的重要性受到关注，但缺乏局部化的版本。
AI.method: 首先建立带符号图的顶点局部化 Turán 型不等式并刻画极图。然后利用该局部参数推导带符号图最大特征值的上界。最后将基于 walk 的局部谱 Turán 不等式推广到带符号图。
AI.result: 建立了带符号图的局部 Turán 不等式，刻画了取等极图。得到了带符号图最大特征值通过局部 Turán 参数的精确上界。推广了基于 walk 的局部谱 Turán 不等式。
AI.conclusion: 统一并推广了无符号和带符号图的多个现有定理，为带符号图的谱 Turán 理论提供了新工具。
AI.future_work: 局部 Turán 参数在其他谱不变量（如 Laplacian 特征值、无符号特征值）上的应用。有向图的局部谱 Turán 理论。

title: An Explicit Surjectivity Threshold for Digit Sums of Primes
summary: Let $s(n)=s_{10}(n)$ be the decimal sum-of-digits map. Building on the circle-method framework of Drmota-Mauduit-Rivat for digital restrictions on primes, we make the constants explicit at the points needed to obtain an effective surjectivity statement for digit sums of primes. We exhibit an explicit integer $M < 1.78 \times 10^{32}$ such that every integer $m \ge M$ with gcd$(m,9)=1$ occurs as $s(p)$ for at least one prime $p$. We also prove an explicit lower bound $A_m(10^{2m/9}) \ge C_q(m) 10^{2m/9}/m^{3/2}$, where $C_q(m)$ is explicit, positive above the sufficient threshold, and bounded away from $0$ along each admissible residue class. Existence of a non-numerical threshold follows from the DMR asymptotic theory and was noted by Harman; to the best of our knowledge, this is the first published explicit numerical threshold for this surjectivity statement. The proof combines explicit major-arc estimates, a fully explicit replacement for DMR's implicit prime exponential-sum input, and constant-tracked Type-II minor-arc estimates. As an application, we prove the infinitude of OEIS A070027, the primes whose iterated digit-sum chain remains prime until reaching a one-digit prime. We also record related effective consequences for additive primes and digit-sum additive decompositions.

AI.tldr: 给出素数数字和的满射性的首个显式数值阈值：所有 $m \ge 1.78 \times 10^{32}$ 且与 9 互素的整数都是某素数的十进制数字和。
AI.motivation: Drmota-Mauduit-Rivat 的圆法理论给出了素数数字和的渐近分布，但非数值的。Harman 注意到满射性的存在性但无阈值。实际应用需要显式常数。
AI.method: 将 DMR 圆法框架中的所有常数显式化：主要弧估计、完全显式的素数指数和替代、常数跟踪的 Type-II 次要弧估计。通过仔细跟踪所有隐常数的依赖关系获得具体数值。
AI.result: 显式给出 $M < 1.78 \times 10^{32}$，使得所有 $m \ge M$ 且 $\gcd(m,9)=1$ 都满足 $m=s(p)$ 对某个素数 $p$ 成立。作为应用，证明 OEIS A070027（迭代数字和链保持素数的素数）是无穷的。
AI.conclusion: 首次给出素数数字和满射性的显式数值阈值，将渐近理论转化为可检验的具体结果。
AI.future_work: 能否降低 $1.78 \times 10^{32}$ 这个阈值？其他数字限制（如数字的串行模式）的显式版本。
